criterion: which type of event the trigger word stated at the end of the text ("The event trigger is ...") denotes

categories.name: Marriage
categories.definition: Events involving the act of getting married, being married, or the state of being a spouse.

categories.name: Education
categories.definition: Events involving the act of studying, being a student, graduating, or the administration of schools and universities.

categories.name: Military Command
categories.definition: Events involving the holding of, transfer of, or acting in a military command position.

categories.name: Competition Result
categories.definition: Events describing the outcome of a competition, such as winning a medal or achieving a specific rank.

categories.name: Employment
categories.definition: Events involving holding a job, position, or role, including hiring, firing, and retirement.

categories.name: Musician
categories.definition: Events identifying an individual as a singer, player, or member of a musical group.

categories.name: Military Personnel
categories.definition: Events identifying an individual as a soldier, sailor, or other military service member.

categories.name: Leadership
categories.definition: Events identifying an individual as the head, leader, or president of an organization, political entity, or group.

categories.name: Academic Position
categories.definition: Events identifying an individual as a professor, lecturer, or academic administrator.

categories.name: Sports Role
categories.definition: Events identifying an individual as a player, coach, or athlete in a sporting context.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: Events involving the creation, production, or performance of an artistic work such as a film, book, or music.

categories.name: Transaction
categories.definition: Events involving the exchange, purchase, trade, or giving of goods, services, or money.

categories.name: Residence
categories.definition: Events involving living in, moving to, or being a resident of a specific place.

categories.name: Conflict Action
categories.definition: Events involving specific actions occurring during conflict or protests, such as attacks, sieges, or rallies.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Events involving the act of speaking, stating, calling, or explaining something.

categories.name: Movement
categories.definition: Events involving physical movement, travel, or transportation from one place to another.

categories.name: Social Relationship
categories.definition: Events describing personal relationships such as being a partner, rival, or family member.

categories.name: Administrative Action
categories.definition: Events involving official or bureaucratic actions such as ordering, banning, or authorizing.
